text.tspan: Average effective age of retirement for men 1970 to 2018
Estimates are based on a weighted average of changes in labour force participation rates by age, for workers

tspan.tspan: OECD (2018) - Database on Average Effective Retirement Age
The estimate for each year corresponds to the 5-year interval leading up to that year (e.g. 1970 corresponds to period 1965-70)
